changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE payments DROP CONSTRAINT chk_payments_purpose, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_payments_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('OUTRIGHT', 'DEPOSIT', 'INSTALMENT', 'BALANCE')), ADD COLUMN instalment_sequence integer, ADD COLUMN finance_verified_at timestamp(6) with time zone, ADD COLUMN finance_verified_by uuid REFERENCES users (id), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_payments_instalment_sequence CHECK ((purpose = 'INSTALMENT') = (instalment_sequence IS NOT NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_payments_finance_verified CHECK (finance_verified_at IS NULL OR status = 'SUCCEEDED'); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_payments_one_verified_instalment ON payments (transaction_id, instalment_sequence) WHERE purpose = 'INSTALMENT' AND finance_verified_at IS NOT NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN payments.finance_verified_at IS 'When the developer''s finance verified this payment (never automatic). Per payment, because an instalment purchase takes many.';
UPDATE payments p SET finance_verified_at = t.updated_at FROM transactions t WHERE t.id = p.transaction_id AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND t.status IN ('VERIFIED', 'ON_PLAN') AND p.review_reason IS NULL;
changeSet.rollback: DROP INDEX uq_payments_one_verified_instalment; ALTER TABLE payments DROP CONSTRAINT chk_payments_finance_verified, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_payments_instalment_sequence, DROP COLUMN finance_verified_by, DROP COLUMN finance_verified_at, DROP COLUMN instalment_sequence, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_payments_purpose, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_payments_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('OUTRIGHT', 'DEPOSIT'));
